intent.proves: At least one active assortment is related to a product group, a product or a shop.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.AssortmentID) FROM EcomAssortments a WHERE a.AssortmentActive = 1 AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomAssortmentGroupRelations g WHERE g.AssortmentGroupRelationAssortmentID = a.AssortmentID) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomAssortmentProductRelations p WHERE p.AssortmentProductRelationAssortmentID = a.AssortmentID) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomAssortmentShopRelations s WHERE s.AssortmentShopRelationAssortmentID = a.AssortmentID))
